question.text: A PM's portfolio drifted to 75% equity from 65% target. Appropriate action is:

answer.text: Leave it and hope market continues
Rebalance via selling some equity and/or buying bonds to restore 65%

explanation.text: The Logic: Rebalancing discipline: restore target weights. Sells winners, buys losers — classic mean-reversion. The Trap: 'Leave and hope' = style drift; sell-all abandons strategy. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 21 deep-dives. Manager's Pro-Tip: Rebalance bands (±5-10%) prevent excessive trading — calendar + threshold hybrid is common.
